name: @ever-works/linear-connector-plugin
description: Linear connector plugin for Ever Works platform (outbound issue comments via @linear/sdk and event-source pull of issues/comments into the event-ingest pipeline, with opt-in historical backfill)

plugin.name: Linear Connector
plugin.description: Linear connector. Outbound posts comments on Linear issues via the official @linear/sdk. Event-source pull ingests issues (created/updated) and comments since the last watermark into the platform event-ingest pipeline, with opt-in historical backfill (backfillDays, max 90).

teamIds.title: Team ids to ingest events from (comma-separated; all teams when empty)

backfillDays.title: Historical backfill window in days on first pull (0 = off, max 90)

defaultIssueId.title: Default issue id for outbound comments
